annotations.title: Spend profiles, approvals and audit trail

description: Read the controls that govern the payments an agent prepares for an organisation: its spend profiles with today's and this month's spend against each budget, the payments waiting for a person to approve (with any transaction already prepared after approval), and the audit trail of prepared and confirmed payments. With approval_id, reads that one approval. Read-only. Needs the organisation's key.

approval_id.description: rapr_… returned by prepare_payment when a person must approve.
